title: 零号中转站
subtitle: SWITCHYARD ZERO / HEAVY CARGO
brief: 回收西库、东侧开放集装箱与高架桥上的三枚能源核心，自选顺序送回南侧运载车。搬运时无法开火，核心会发热；Q 可放下应战。回收触发守备增援，留意方向预警并利用补给点。装满后在路由台选择西线或东线，靠近车辆按住 E 出发。留在车旁护送至北方出口，遭袭时可消耗维修包修车。
objectives: 回收核心 · 自选顺序

en.title: Switchyard Zero
en.brief: Recover three energy cores from the west warehouse, east open container and upper walkway. Return them to the south carrier in any order. Carrying blocks fire and builds heat; Q drops the core so you can fight. Recovery triggers reinforcements: watch direction warnings and use supplies. Once loaded, choose west or east at the route console, then hold E near the carrier to depart. Stay close and escort it to the north exit. Repair kits restore carrier health.
objectives: Choose a route and start transport
Escort the carrier to the north terminal
